decisions.briefing: Markets were mildly risk-on today (NASDAQ +0.7%, S&P 500 +0.5%), but the signal isn't strong enough to justify deploying capital, and available cash ($189.29) is below the $500 threshold needed for a new position anyway. Holding all 7 existing positions and letting stop-loss/profit-target rules manage them automatically.

market_education.summary_en: Both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 posted modest gains today, reflecting a mildly positive but not decisive shift in investor sentiment. Without a strong breakout signal (like the +2% moves that typically indicate broad institutional buying), this looks more like routine drift than a clear risk-on rally. No major single catalyst stands out from today's session.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日納斯達克及標普500指數均錄得溫和升幅，反映投資者情緒略為正面，但未見明顯突破性訊號。由於升幅未達到一般代表機構資金大舉入市的+2%水平，今日走勢較像是溫和整固而非明確的風險偏好回升，暫未見有單一重大消息主導市場。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a genuinely strong opportunity appears. Today's gains were modest and cash on hand is limited, so holding rather than forcing a trade preserves flexibility for a clearer setup later.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「彈藥」（Dry Powder）指投資者預留在場邊、等待真正理想機會才動用的現金。今日升幅溫和，加上手頭現金有限，因此按兵不動、保留彈性，待更明確的入市訊號出現時再行動，是較穩健的做法。
